input.overview: Pat Hand pays through the rollover disks above and beside the upper-left flipper. Soft-plunge across the top disks, then use the upper-left feed and right flipper to send the ball back up. Build Bonus to 10,000 before completing A-K-Q-J-10 twice for lit disks, stronger bumpers, and Double Bonus.
input.simpleOverview: In Pat Hand, soft-plunge across the top rollover disks and keep sending the ball back up from the right flipper. Build Bonus to 10,000, then complete A-K-Q-J-10 once to light the disks for 1,000 and twice to light Double Bonus. Avoid forcing the rebound-heavy Joker targets.
input.summary: Repeat the safe top-disk loop. Once base Bonus is 10,000, finish the five center cards twice: the first completion lights the rollover disks and bumpers, and the second lights Double Bonus. A third completion can light Special when that award matters.

quickInfo.name: Top rollover disks
quickInfo.summary: Advance Bonus and become worth 1,000 after the first A-K-Q-J-10 completion.

quickInfo.name: First card completion
quickInfo.summary: Lights the rollover disks for 1,000 and the pop bumpers for 100.

quickInfo.name: Joker targets
quickInfo.summary: Completing all four can award Extra Ball when enabled, but their rebounds are dangerous.

steps.text: Soft-plunge so the ball crosses as many top rollover disks as possible.
Use the upper-left feed and right flipper to return the ball to the top disk arc.
Repeat the top loop until base Bonus reaches its 10,000 maximum.
Complete A-K-Q-J-10 once to light the disks and bumpers, then complete the cards again to light Double Bonus.
Return to the top-disk loop and avoid the Joker targets unless Extra Ball is enabled and worth the rebound risk.

buildsToward.title: Lit rollover disks and doubled maximum Bonus

steps.text: Build the base Bonus to 10,000 through the top disks.
Complete the center cards once to raise disk and bumper scoring.
Complete them a second time for Double Bonus, then resume the top loop.

machineSetup: Confirm whether Extra Ball and Special are enabled or converted, and whether the installed game awards anything useful for a third center-card completion.
Test every top and upper-left rollover disk, all five center card targets and completion lamps, four Joker targets, both pop bumpers, the Bonus unit, and feeds from both sides of the top arc.

playfieldReferences.description: Top arc switches that build Bonus and later score 1,000 each.

playfieldReferences.label: Upper-left flipper
playfieldReferences.description: Flipper used to recycle the ball through the rollover-disk route.

playfieldReferences.description: Five targets whose repeated completions light higher scoring and Double Bonus.

playfieldReferences.label: Four Joker targets
playfieldReferences.description: Risky side targets that can light Extra Ball when all four are collected.
